# Build It

> > Build It is the UK's leading resource for self-build, renovation, and home improvement projects, covering timber frame construction, Passivhaus design, heat pumps, and sustainable building methods.

Build It provides comprehensive guides, cost references, and expert advice for self-builders and renovators in the UK. The site covers everything from construction budgeting and insurance to cutting-edge building technologies like SIPs, timber frame systems, and integrated climate control solutions.

## Key Topics

- Self-build projects
- Air Source Heat Pumps (ASHP)
- Timber frame construction
- Passivhaus design
- Structural Insulated Panels (SIPs)
- Retrofit and renovation
- Building costs and budgeting
- Home heating systems
- Construction methods
- Prime costs and provisional sums
- Whole-house climate systems
- Beam and block flooring
- Building regulations UK
- Energy efficiency
- Build It Live Shows

## Planning & Budgeting

- [Self Build Insurance - What Insurance You Need & When](https://www.self-build.co.uk/self-build-insurance-the-ultimate-checklist): Complete insurance checklist for self-build projects with timing guide
- [What Are Prime Costs and Provisional Sums?](https://www.self-build.co.uk/what-are-prime-costs-and-provisional-sums): Explains prime costs & provisional sums for self-build budgeting
- [Cost Guide: Walls and Insulation](https://www.self-build.co.uk/cost-guide-walls-and-insulation): Pricing guide for cavity walls, insulation & alternative construction

## Building Methods & Construction Systems

- [3 Steps to a Successful Timber Self Build](https://www.self-build.co.uk/the-3-stages-of-a-timber-self-build): Structural Timber Association guide to timber self-build design & systems
- [How to Get the Best out of Building with SIPs](https://www.self-build.co.uk/best-performance-building-with-sips): Effective structural insulated panels (SIPs) usage for self-builds
- [Discover Innovations in Timber Frame Technology](https://www.self-build.co.uk/discover-innovations-in-timber-frame-technology): Cutting-edge timber frame solutions for sustainable self-builds
- [Beam and Block Flooring – What Are the Benefits?](https://www.self-build.co.uk/benefits-block-beam-flooring): Benefits of beam & block flooring for durable self-build construction
- [How to Choose an Upper-Storey Floor Structure](https://www.self-build.co.uk/specifying-upper-storey-floor-structures): Selecting intermediate floor structures for multi-storey self-builds

## Heat Pumps & Climate Systems

- [How to Retrofit an Air Source Heat Pump – Your Guide to Installing an ASHP in an Existing Home](https://www.self-build.co.uk/retrofit-air-source-heat-pump): Complete guide to retrofitting ASHPs in existing homes with cost savings
- [How Much Does it Cost to Retrofit a Heat Pump & How Much Can You Save?](https://www.self-build.co.uk/retrofitting-a-heat-pump): Heat pump retrofit costs, savings & factors influencing installation price
- [Can Heat Pumps be Quiet? Reducing Heat Pump Noise at Home](https://www.self-build.co.uk/can-heat-pumps-be-quiet-reducing-heat-pump-noise-at-home): Expert guide to achieving quiet heat pump installations & noise reduction
- [What Are the Benefits of a Whole-House Integrated Climate System?](https://www.self-build.co.uk/what-are-the-benefits-of-a-whole-house-integrated-climate-system): Guide to integrated heat pump climate systems for energy-efficient homes

## Home Design & Architecture

- [10 Top Tips for Home Design](https://www.self-build.co.uk/how-to-design-a-home-10-tips): 10 essential design tips covering storage, lighting & home maintenance
- [In The Frame: Designing & Building a Passivhaus](https://www.self-build.co.uk/in-the-frame-designing-building-a-passivhaus): Oak frame Passivhaus design & construction guide with podcast
- [Internal Glazing Options: Create a Flexible Living Space](https://www.self-build.co.uk/internal-glazing-options-create-a-flexible-living-space): Internal glazing solutions for flexible living space design
- [How to Design a Hallway – Entryway Ideas & Expert Advice](https://www.self-build.co.uk/guide-designing-hallway): Expert tips for impactful hallway & entryway design
